profile.headline: Software Developer I @ Topre America Corporation | ex-Bosch

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
- Led the development of a Material Tracking System, using C# and .NET10 for backend functionality and Angular 21 with TypeScript for frontend development, ensuring a seamless and responsive user experience.

- Enhanced the company's ERP system by integrating new features, significantly improving efficiency by 80% and overall user experience (UX/UI).

- Designed and developed data reports with Grafana, providing actionable insights for strategic decision-making.

- Crafted complex SQL queries for real-time data insights, streamlining operational processes (Stored Procedures, Jobs, Views).

- Developed training material and conducted sessions for ERP system users, driving system adoption.

- Managed code versioning using Git, ensuring smooth collaboration and code integrity.

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer Trainee
positions.description:
- Specialized in laser weld quality control, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives in the production line.

- Analyzed manufacturing processes, identified inefficiencies, and proposed data-driven solutions to enhance productivity and reduce waste.

positions.title: IT Trainee - BI Developer (Business Intelligence)
positions.description:
- Executed complex SQL queries for real-time analytics, enhancing decision-making efficiency.

- Collaborated in a multicultural team, improving cross-functional communication and problem-solving.

- Analyzed data to identify trends, contributing to strategic planning with actionable insights.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Microsoft SQL Server · Business Analytics · Data Analytics · Cross-cultural Teams

positions.title: Co-Owner
positions.description: Skills: Statistical Data Analysis · Accounting · Sales

positions.title: Jr Hardware Requirements Engineer
positions.description:
- Managed hardware needs in DOORS, boosting project precision and workflow.

- Authored clear requirements, aligning with project objectives for success.

- Developed VBA Macros, enhancing DOORS efficiency and operational ease.

positions.title: Methods Engineer - Bosch Engineering Systems & Methods
positions.description:
- Developed VBA macros improving form management and database efficiency.

- Created relational databases in Excel for enhanced report generation.

- Built KPIs reports in Power BI utilizing Excel and SQL for data insights.

- Implemented system for documenting Engineering Change Requests, training provided.

- Collaborated with global teams, facilitating remote work integration.

positions.title: Controls Teacher (PLC Programming)
positions.locationName: San Luis Potosí y alrededores, México
positions.description:
• Training and advisory to engineering students regarding PLC programming and industrial networks (PLC related).

• Programming of Siemens PLCs of the series 300 and 1200 using Step7 and TIA Portal environments.

• Training on how to read sensors signals, actuators handling and communication among PLCs

• Used networks for the lessons:
  -PROFIBUS
  -PROFINET
  -MPI

• Actuators handling and sensor signals reading through AS-i.

• HMI's development using TIA-Portal environment.

• Final project applying most of the technologies reviewed during the sessions.
positions.insights: Skills: Profinet · Profibus · Teaching · HMI Programming · MPI · PLC Siemens

volunteerExperiences.description:
Program taking place in Cullman, AL to support Mexican adults in the U.S. to achieve their basic education diplomas (equivalent to U.S. grades 1-12). 

Developed and delivered lessons in foundational mathematics, contributing to adult learners' academic growth and personal empowerment.
